'''AestheTech Incorporated''' was a beauty company in business during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. They were the producers of the [[Appearance Designer]], a device that could alter any part of the body. While the technical specifications of the Appearance Designer were a well kept secret, all major galactic medical and safety organizations had approved of it.
